The open question is what happens to active report filters when the user switches workspaces. The new setting's default decides how the reported bug behaves without user action.

A) Reset all filters on switch by default, so the new workspace opens unfiltered. The resolver setting lets users opt out and keep filters.

B) Keep today's carry-over behavior by default. The resolver setting lets users opt in to resetting on switch.

C) Remember filters per workspace. Switching restores that workspace's last filters, or none on first visit, and the setting turns this memory on or off.

Recommendation: A - stale filters hiding rows in the new workspace is the reported defect. Defaulting to reset fixes it out of the box. It also keeps the setting a single resolver-owned flag, with no new per-workspace state.
